searchText: Are those besu bad blocks accounted for or does someone from besu need to look at them? it might be useful to take a look, but not really sure how accurate it is. As most besu nodes seem to be able to track to HEAD. is it valid to use V1 fcU and retrieve a block with V2 getPayload with no withdrawals? https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/blob/main/src/engine/shanghai.md#engine_getpayloadv2 and https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/blob/main/src/engine/paris.md#specification-1 aren't clear on this that I can tell whats the alternative? fcu hasn't changed, and at the appropriate time you'd want to start using getPayloadV2 fcU has changed though? there's the paris and shanghai versions. but the only change is the addition of `withdrawals`. this the question. yes, sorry it must change, i confused myself earlier the strictest thing is to only allow `getPayloadV2` for `forkchoiceUpdatedV2` and i'd say this is the intention behind the spec as written now that being said, clients could interpret `PayloadAttributesV1` as a `PayloadAttributesV2` with an empty `[]` withdrawals array i think we should make the spec explicit that calling fcuV1 and using that `payloadID` on `getPayloadV2` is an error otherwise we just need to handle some ambiguous case(s) or do something like version the `payloadID` itself do you (or anyone reading this) have a preference? i can put together a PR soon I'd prefer requiring an exact match. if there proves some good reason later, can loosen it and prefer not versioning the payload ID yeah agree, i'll try to put up a PR tomorrow

excerpts.author: tersec
excerpts.content: is it valid to use V1 fcU and retrieve a block with V2 getPayload with no withdrawals? https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/blob/main/src/engine/shanghai.md#engine_getpayloadv2 and https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/blob/main/src/engine/paris.md#specification-1 aren't clear on this that I can tell

excerpts.author: ralexstokes
excerpts.content: fcu hasn't changed, and at the appropriate time you'd want to start using getPayloadV2

excerpts.author: tersec
excerpts.content: fcU has changed though? there's the paris and shanghai versions. but the only change is the addition of `withdrawals`. this the question.

excerpts.author: ralexstokes
excerpts.content: yes, sorry it must change, i confused myself earlier

excerpts.author: ralexstokes
excerpts.content: the strictest thing is to only allow `getPayloadV2` for `forkchoiceUpdatedV2` and i'd say this is the intention behind the spec as written now

excerpts.author: ralexstokes
excerpts.content: that being said, clients could interpret `PayloadAttributesV1` as a `PayloadAttributesV2` with an empty `[]` withdrawals array

excerpts.author: ralexstokes
excerpts.content: i think we should make the spec explicit that calling fcuV1 and using that `payloadID` on `getPayloadV2` is an error

excerpts.author: ralexstokes
excerpts.content: otherwise we just need to handle some ambiguous case(s) or do something like version the `payloadID` itself

excerpts.author: ralexstokes
excerpts.content: do you (or anyone reading this)  have a preference?

excerpts.author: ralexstokes
excerpts.content: i can put together a PR soon

excerpts.author: tersec
excerpts.content: I'd prefer requiring an exact match. if there proves some good reason later, can loosen it

excerpts.author: tersec
excerpts.content: and prefer not versioning the payload ID

excerpts.author: ralexstokes
excerpts.content: yeah agree, i'll try to put up a PR tomorrow
